instance_description:
Setting: During 2026, this instance covers a private-pilot ground-school and flight-training syllabus at a civilian flying club, local airport classrooms, simulator rooms, and an FAA testing center.
Scope: Recurring areas include lesson preparation, aircraft-systems study, weather and navigation exercises, simulator practice, dual instructional flights, stage checks, written-test readiness, logbook review, and training costs.
Resources: Reusable records track learner-owned training items, scheduled training events, and proficiency requirements; blank files support lesson notes, exam review, and instructor-message drafting; a personal wallet handles authorized expenses.
Exclusions: It excludes recreational travel, aircraft ownership, paid aviation work, official FAA systems, instructor endorsements, safety-critical dispatch decisions, and other students’ records.
personal_description:
Identity: Mira Elowen Thorne is an adult learner pursuing private-pilot certificate preparation throughout 2026 through a flying club’s structured ground and flight-training program.
Responsibilities: She manages study plans, homework, simulator preparation, dual-flight readiness, stage-check evidence, written-test practice, logbook questions, instructor follow-up, and personal education spending.
Authority: Mira may organize her own learning records, draft submissions and messages, request permitted lesson scheduling, buy study materials, and track personal progress against the syllabus.
Restrictions: She cannot endorse herself, alter official logbook entries, approve solo flight, dispatch aircraft, override weather or safety policies, access restricted club systems, or make decisions for instructors or other students.
